Added.Description: It takes the following values: [Thin/Thick], [Flush], [FullLength], [Double] Thin: specifies a thin line border. Thick: specifies a thick line border. Flush: When space top/bottom is used in line/part etc. this can be used so that the space will be left at top/bottom after the border. Full Length: It draws the complete border including specified space left/right. Double: It draws double lined border.
